summary.text: Mark Abraham is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 25 (Acadia, Calcasieu, Cameron and Jefferson Davis parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official Senate member page. Mark Abraham is vice chair of the Judiciary C Committee.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as Louisiana State University, B.S. in Accounting.

The page lists committee assignments including Judiciary C (vice chair), Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs, Finance, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
